title: 美股周评 · 2026-10-17：结构未稳，硬件转弱
title_en: U.S. Market Weekly Review · 2026-10-17: Fragile internals; AI hardware weakens
subtitle: 模型口径调整后，先看绝对风险与内部结构
subtitle_en: After the framework change, focus on absolute risk and market internals
author: Taiyang Feng (Sunny)
summary: 综合状态保留 10 月 15 日的 58.1 / 谨慎读数，不能与上周直接比较。脆弱性仍为 93.3，AI 硬件降至 11.5 / Weak，SMH 近 20 日下跌 5.8%。周频模型为 Level 5 / 35%，信用输入滞后一个交易日，拟于 10 月 19 日生效；研究判断仍以防守和交叉验证为主。
summary_en: The retained October 15 composite reading is 58.1 / Caution and is not directly comparable with last week. Fragility remains 93.3, AI hardware is 11.5 / Weak, and SMH lost 5.8% over 20 trading days. The weekly model is Level 5 / 35%, using credit input lagged one session and effective October 19. The research stance remains defensive and evidence-led.

## 本期判断：数字变了，结构仍需防守

本期周评以 10 月 16 日为主要观察截止日。综合市场状态页面保留的最新读数为 58.1 / Caution，实际数据日是 10 月 15 日，状态仍为 PENDING_SOURCE。本周模型框架及来源衔接发生调整，不能把它与上期 65.8 直接相减，解释为市场风险明显下降。[1]

在这份保留快照中，市场风险 55.5、参与度风险 56.8，均处谨慎；金融压力 26.9 处建设性；脆弱性仍高达 93.3。总体风险并非所有维度同时恶化，但内部结构的压力还没有消失。月度宽度均值约 40%，也不能单凭一个较低综合分数宣布市场恢复健康。[1]

半导体与 AI 硬件提供了更直接的弱化证据：综合分数 11.5 / Weak，需求动量接近零，SMH 近 5 日下跌 10.53%、近 20 日下跌 5.80%。本期研究判断仍以防守为主，等待参与、趋势与数据完整性共同确认；模型参考敞口不是作者或任何账户的实际仓位。[1]

## 市场状态：保留读数，分开讨论风险与版本

58.1 是四支柱在本期显示口径下的综合值，不是危机发生概率。脆弱性 93.3 与金融压力 26.9 之间的差距，反映结构性压力与金融条件并未给出同等强度的信号。谨慎状态仍要求关注参与面、集中与共同调整风险，而不是将单一状态标签当作交易指令。[1]

页面明确显示：综合状态实际数据截至 10 月 15 日，更新结果为 COMPLETED_WITH_SOURCE_GAP / PENDING_SOURCE。因子来源迁移尚未完全通过发布门槛，既有综合状态及相关显示值被保留。本报告保留这些观察日和状态，不将截图制作日或任务运行完成日替代数据日期。[1]

因此，本期不画跨版本的周环比连线，也不计算相对上期的风险下降幅度。后续要检验风险改善，需要先获得同一发布口径的可比序列，再观察参与度、脆弱性与信用输入是否共同改善。保留的旧版加权值 57.2 也不能与正式 58.1 混为同一指标。[1]

## 广度、金融条件与因子：定义和日期先行

首页约 40% 的市场宽度是 9 月 30 日两项月度指标的均值：站上 200 日均线的比例为 43.51%，过去 12 个月跑赢基准的比例为 36.52%，平均 40.02%。10 月 16 日的日度 200DMA 估计另为 41.72%，对应 1,395 / 3,344 个有效样本；二者并非同一频率或同一定义。[1]

NFCI / ANFCI 截至 10 月 9 日，分别为 -0.499 与 -0.485，差值 -0.014。负的指数水平与较宽松的金融条件一致，但近 4 周分别上升 0.037 和 0.068，说明边际方向仍需关注。金融压力支柱较低，并不意味着信用数据缺口可以忽略，也不能证明所有流动性渠道均无压力。[1][4]

因子拥挤度中的剔除市场因子多空版本为 0.758 / L3，beta 调整多头版本为 0.872 / L4，观察期均为 8 月末。另一个估值层的 HML 约第 98.8 百分位（界面四舍五入为 99%），含义为价值相对更便宜，并非 99% 拥挤；UMD 约第 25.7 百分位的方向则相反。两者仍属于来源迁移中的保留显示，不是本周新通过验证的因子发布。[1]

## AI 硬件：趋势支撑与参与面同步转弱

截至 10 月 16 日，半导体与 AI 硬件综合分数为 11.5 / Weak。需求动量原始读数约 0.5（界面取整为 0），领导力宽度约 8.9，供应链确认约 8.3，相对风险偏好约 30.5。低分在这套模型中代表趋势支撑弱，与综合市场风险模型的高分高风险方向不同。[1]

28 只监测股票中，没有一只站上 20 日均线，仅 2 只站上 50 日均线，占 7.1%；这不是 200 日均线广度。该样本的近 20 日上涨比例为 17.9%。弱化不仅存在于综合分数，还体现在短中期参与及多数个股的价格表现上。[1]

行业拥挤 / 热度已降至 29.8 / Cool，但分化脆弱性仍为 73.5 / Elevated。降温并不等于趋势修复：当需求、领导力和供应链确认都偏弱时，低热度可能与价格回撤并存。更积极的判断仍需等待更多个股重新站回均线、相对表现与多个研究支柱共同改善。[1]

## 行业内部：相对优势也已转弱

SMH 近 20 日下跌 5.80%，比 SPY 低 6.00 个百分点、比 QQQ 低 4.18 个百分点；近 5 日下跌 10.53%。同期 SPY 近 20 日小幅上涨 0.20%，QQQ 下跌 1.61%。行业承压既包含绝对回撤，也包含相对大盘的落后。[1]

五个子产业的近 20 日平均价格变化均为负：模拟 / MCU / 功率约 -0.97%，晶圆代工与设备 -6.42%，AI 加速器 -8.27%，服务器与网络硬件 -17.34%，存储 -21.28%。这是固定监测分组内的简单均值，不是可投资组合收益，也不代表整个产业链的市值加权表现。[1]

个别相对抗跌股票不等于领导力广泛恢复。近 20 日表现较好的 ADI、TXN、ON，与较弱的 COHR、STX、WDC 同时存在；但所有监测股票均在 20 日均线下方。后续更值得观察的是参与扩散、相对趋势与供应链确认，而不是从少数抗跌名称推导全面复苏。[1]

## 利率：近周缓和，中期约束仍在

纽约联储 ACM 截至 10 月 15 日的 10 年期拟合收益率为 5.075%，其中预期平均短端利率分项为 4.327%，期限溢价为 0.747%。两项之和构成拟合收益率；它不是当日实际成交的国债收益率，也不直接预测下次政策决策。[1][3]

在 9 月 15 日至 10 月 15 日的一个月窗口，拟合收益率上升 10.01 bp，其中预期分项贡献 5.79 bp、期限溢价贡献 4.22 bp。三个月、六个月和一年窗口累计变化仍分别为 +47.00、+75.23 和 +97.32 bp，预期分项在这些窗口均贡献更多。[1][3]

同一份当前数据中，10 月 8 日至 15 日的拟合收益率下降 14.21 bp：预期分项上升 3.02 bp，而期限溢价下降 17.23 bp。近周边际缓和与过去一个月仍上行可以同时成立。这里比较的是同一数据版本及明确起止日，不将它与上期已发表版本的数值差异混为市场变化。[1]

## 下一期：防守判断，等待共同确认

本期周频风险模型信号日为 10 月 16 日，Level 5，参考风险敞口 35%，拟生效日为 10 月 19 日。状态为 CURRENT_WITH_LAGGED_INPUTS：它是在模型允许的滞后规则下可用的本周信号，不是沿用上周信号，但也不是所有输入均已齐备的完整结果。[1]

高收益利差 BAMLH0A0HYM2 实际只到 10 月 15 日，比目标截止日少一个交易日。其状态为正常等待发布；本期不虚构 10 月 16 日的信用变化，也不提前判断补齐后等级会怎样改变。待正式观察到达，应重新核对参考敞口、信用方向与其余风险支柱。[1][5]

观察顺序保持清楚：先验证来源和模型口径是否完成衔接，再观察全市场参与及脆弱性，然后检验 AI 硬件的均线广度、相对表现与需求 / 供应链确认。利率边际缓和是独立线索，不能单独抵消结构压力。截图中的 Livermore S2 为 40.4 / Normal，它不是直接的系统流动性指标。[1]

## 数据、方法与披露

本期观察截止日为 2026-10-16，周评期日为 10 月 17 日，中英文制作及首次发布日为 10 月 18 日。输入已冻结，不触发模型更新或重算。来源日期不同：综合状态及估值层保留至 10-15，股票及行业指标至 10-16，ACM 至 10-15，NFCI / ANFCI 至 10-09，月度宽度至 09-30，因子拥挤度至 08-31。[1]

综合风险状态与 AI 硬件状态为不同模型，分数方向不能混用。综合风险区间为 <35 建设性、35 至 <50 中性、50 至 <65 谨慎、65 至 <80 防御、>=80 压力。本期沿用显示值，不把尚待来源验证的因子迁移说成已经完成，也不将月度、日度与不同样本的宽度拼成一条时间序列。[1]

价格变化按现有看板的调整价格输入计算，不是独立重建的含息总回报。行业只有 28 只监测股票；宽度有效样本和覆盖率随口径变化。ACM 是模型分解，单位为百分比；变化以 bp 计，1 bp = 0.01 个百分点。未来日期的独立 WQS 卡片不作为已实现观察；封面山景仅为品牌图像。[1][2][3]

本材料由 Residual Inertia | 余势制作，作者 Taiyang Feng (Sunny)，仅用于独立研究与信息交流，不构成投资或证券交易建议。模型参考敞口不代表实际持仓；历史表现、模型状态与情景判断均不保证未来结果。

纽约联储 ACM 截至 10 月 15 日的 10 年期拟合收益率为 5.075%，其中预期平均短端利率分项为 4.327%，期限溢价为 0.747%。两项之和构成拟合收益率；它不是当日实际成交的国债收益率，也不直接预测下次政策决策。[1][3]

在 9 月 15 日至 10 月 15 日的一个月窗口，拟合收益率上升 10.01 bp，其中预期分项贡献 5.79 bp、期限溢价贡献 4.22 bp。三个月、六个月和一年窗口累计变化仍分别为 +47.00、+75.23 和 +97.32 bp，预期分项在这些窗口均贡献更多。[1][3]

同一份当前数据中，10 月 8 日至 15 日的拟合收益率下降 14.21 bp：预期分项上升 3.02 bp，而期限溢价下降 17.23 bp。近周边际缓和与过去一个月仍上行可以同时成立。这里比较的是同一数据版本及明确起止日，不将它与上期已发表版本的数值差异混为市场变化。[1]

## 下一期：防守判断，等待共同确认

本期周频风险模型信号日为 10 月 16 日，Level 5，参考风险敞口 35%，拟生效日为 10 月 19 日。状态为 CURRENT_WITH_LAGGED_INPUTS：它是在模型允许的滞后规则下可用的本周信号，不是沿用上周信号，但也不是所有输入均已齐备的完整结果。[1]

高收益利差 BAMLH0A0HYM2 实际只到 10 月 15 日，比目标截止日少一个交易日。其状态为正常等待发布；本期不虚构 10 月 16 日的信用变化，也不提前判断补齐后等级会怎样改变。待正式观察到达，应重新核对参考敞口、信用方向与其余风险支柱。[1][5]

观察顺序保持清楚：先验证来源和模型口径是否完成衔接，再观察全市场参与及脆弱性，然后检验 AI 硬件的均线广度、相对表现与需求 / 供应链确认。利率边际缓和是独立线索，不能单独抵消结构压力。截图中的 Livermore S2 为 40.4 / Normal，它不是直接的系统流动性指标。[1]

## 数据、方法与披露

本期观察截止日为 2026-10-16，周评期日为 10 月 17 日，中英文制作及首次发布日为 10 月 18 日。输入已冻结，不触发模型更新或重算。来源日期不同：综合状态及估值层保留至 10-15，股票及行业指标至 10-16，ACM 至 10-15，NFCI / ANFCI 至 10-09，月度宽度至 09-30，因子拥挤度至 08-31。[1]

本材料由 Residual Inertia | 余势制作，作者 Taiyang Feng (Sunny)，仅用于独立研究与信息交流，不构成投资或证券交易建议。模型参考敞口不代表实际持仓；历史表现、模型状态与情景判断均不保证未来结果。

This review uses October 16 as its main observation cutoff. The latest retained composite is 58.1 / Caution, dated October 15 and still marked PENDING_SOURCE. The framework and source transition changed this week. Subtracting 58.1 from last week's 65.8 would mix vintages and cannot establish a material decline in market risk.[1]

Within the retained snapshot, Market Risk is 55.5 and Participation risk 56.8, both Caution. Financial Stress is 26.9 / Constructive, while Fragility remains 93.3 / Stress. The risks are uneven rather than uniformly systemic, but internal pressure has not disappeared. Monthly composite breadth is about 40%; a lower headline score alone is insufficient evidence of a healthy market.[1]

Semiconductors and AI hardware offer more direct evidence of weakness: the composite is 11.5 / Weak, demand momentum is near zero, and SMH fell 10.53% over five sessions and 5.80% over 20. The research stance remains defensive, pending joint confirmation from participation, trends and input completeness. Model reference exposure is not the author's or any account's actual holdings.[1]

## Separate the retained reading from the model revision

58.1 combines the four displayed pillars under this vintage; it is not a crisis probability. The gap between Fragility at 93.3 and Financial Stress at 26.9 shows that structural pressure and financial conditions do not send equally strong signals. Caution still calls for attention to participation, concentration and correlated adjustment, rather than treating a state label as a trading instruction.[1]

The page explicitly dates the composite to October 15 and labels the update COMPLETED_WITH_SOURCE_GAP / PENDING_SOURCE. The factor-source migration has not fully cleared its publication gate, so existing composite and related displays are retained. This report preserves those observation dates and statuses; neither screenshot creation nor task completion is substituted for a data date.[1]

Accordingly, this edition draws no cross-vintage weekly comparison line and calculates no week-on-week reduction in risk. Testing improvement requires a comparable series under one published methodology, followed by joint checks of participation, fragility and credit inputs. The retained legacy weighted value of 57.2 is also distinct from the official displayed 58.1.[1]

## Breadth, financial conditions and factor definitions

The roughly 40% homepage breadth reading is the mean of two September 30 monthly measures: 43.51% above the 200-day average and 36.52% outperforming the benchmark over 12 months, averaging 40.02%. The separate October 16 daily 200DMA estimate is 41.72%, or 1,395 of 3,344 eligible observations. These differ in frequency and definition.[1]

NFCI and ANFCI are dated October 9, at -0.499 and -0.485, a difference of -0.014. Negative levels are consistent with relatively loose financial conditions, but their four-week increases of 0.037 and 0.068 warrant attention to the direction of change. A low Financial Stress pillar neither removes the credit-input gap nor proves that every liquidity channel is free of pressure.[1][4]

Long-short crowding excluding the market factor is 0.758 / L3; beta-adjusted long-only crowding is 0.872 / L4. Both are end-August observations. In the separate valuation layer, HML is near its 98.8th percentile, displayed as 99%: higher means value is relatively cheaper, not 99% crowded. UMD's 25.7th percentile has the opposite direction. These remain retained displays during the source migration, rather than newly validated factor releases this week.[1]

## AI hardware loses both trend support and participation

As of October 16, the semiconductor and AI hardware composite is 11.5 / Weak. Demand momentum is about 0.5, rounded to 0 on the dashboard; leadership breadth is 8.9, supply-chain confirmation 8.3 and relative risk appetite 30.5. Lower scores mean weaker trend support in this model, unlike the higher-is-riskier direction of the broad-market regime score.[1]

None of the 28 monitored stocks is above its 20-day moving average, and only two are above the 50-day average, or 7.1%. This is not 200DMA breadth. The proportion with positive 20-day returns is 17.9%. Weakness appears in short- and medium-term participation and in most constituent price changes, not just the composite score.[1]

Sector crowding / heat has cooled to 29.8 / Cool, while divergence fragility is still 73.5 / Elevated. Cooling does not establish trend repair: with weak demand, leadership and supply-chain confirmation, lower heat can coexist with falling prices. A more constructive view requires more stocks to regain moving averages and joint improvement in relative performance and several research pillars.[1]

## Relative semiconductor strength has also weakened

SMH lost 5.80% over 20 sessions, trailing SPY by 6.00 percentage points and QQQ by 4.18 points; its five-day loss was 10.53%. Over the same 20-day window SPY gained 0.20% and QQQ lost 1.61%. Sector pressure therefore includes both an absolute drawdown and underperformance relative to broad benchmarks.[1]

All five monitored industry groups have negative mean 20-day price changes: Analog / MCU / Power -0.97%, Foundry & Equipment -6.42%, AI Accelerators -8.27%, Servers & Networking -17.34%, and Memory & Storage -21.28%. These are simple means within the monitored groups, not investable portfolio returns or capitalization-weighted industry performance.[1]

A few relatively resilient stocks do not establish broad leadership repair. ADI, TXN and ON lead the 20-day ranking while COHR, STX and WDC lag, yet every monitored stock remains below its 20-day average. Participation diffusion, relative trends and supply-chain confirmation matter more than inferring a broad recovery from a few resilient names.[1]

## Rates ease over the week but remain a medium-term constraint

The New York Fed ACM ten-year fitted yield is 5.075% as of October 15, comprising a 4.327% expected average short-rate component and a 0.747% term premium. Their sum is the fitted yield, not a traded Treasury quote; it does not directly forecast the next policy decision.[1][3]

Within the same current dataset, the fitted yield fell 14.21 bp from October 8 to 15: expected rates rose 3.02 bp while term premium fell 17.23 bp. Weekly relief and a positive one-month change can coexist. These comparisons use one vintage and explicit endpoints; differences from last week's published vintage are not misidentified as market moves.[1]

## A defensive stance pending joint confirmation

The weekly risk signal is dated October 16: Level 5, with 35% model reference exposure and an October 19 effective date. CURRENT_WITH_LAGGED_INPUTS means it is a current usable signal under the configured lag policy, rather than a retained prior-week signal; it is not an all-inputs-complete result.[1]

The high-yield spread input BAMLH0A0HYM2 only reaches October 15, one trading session short of the target cutoff. Its publication state is a normal wait. This edition invents no October 16 credit observation and makes no advance claim about how completion will affect the level. Keep the validation order clear: first verify the source and methodology transition, then broad participation and fragility, and then AI hardware moving-average breadth, relative performance, demand and supply-chain confirmation. Rate relief is a separate clue and does not alone offset structural pressure. The screenshot's Livermore S2 reading is 40.4 / Normal; it is not a direct systemic-liquidity measure.[1]
